iPod BT Receiver

A Bluetooth audio receiver (A2DP sink) for a jailbroken iPod touch 5 (iOS 6–9.3.5).

This page is a Cydia repository. In Cydia: Sources → Edit → Add, then enter:

Then open BT Receiver (A2DP Sink) and install it.

Source code and releases: github.com/k7vinilstorage/Ipod-Bt-Reciver.
